; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER Trigger V0010_Standard_Battle_Attacker_Crushing_Victory_VnV_Trigger
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     WhenToTest PostBattle

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Condition WasAttacker
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and IsGeneral
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and WonBattle
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleSuccess = crushing
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and I_ConflictType Normal
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleOdds >= 0.5
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleOdds < 1.5
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and not Toggled gradual trait loss

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Affects GoodAttacker  2  Chance  100 
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Affects TacticalSkill  1  Chance  5 

;------------------------------------------
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER Trigger REMASTERED_V0010_Standard_Battle_Attacker_Crushing_Victory_VnV_Trigger
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     WhenToTest PostBattle

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Condition WasAttacker
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and IsGeneral
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and WonBattle
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleSuccess = crushing
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and I_ConflictType Normal
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleOdds >= 0.5
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleOdds < 1.5
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and Toggled gradual trait loss
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and Trait BadAttacker = 0

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Affects GoodAttacker  2  Chance  100 
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Affects TacticalSkill  1  Chance  5 

;------------------------------------------
Trigger REMASTERED_CrushingVictory_lower_bad_attacker
    WhenToTest PostBattle

    Condition WasAttacker
          and IsGeneral
          and WonBattle
          and BattleSuccess = crushing
          and I_ConflictType Normal
          and BattleOdds >= 0.5
          and BattleOdds < 1.5
          and Toggled gradual trait loss
          and Trait BadAttacker > 0

    Affects BadAttacker  Lose  2  Chance  100 
    ; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED Affects TacticalSkill  1  Chance  5

;------------------------------------------
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER Trigger V0020_Standard_Battle_Attacker_Crushing_Loss_VnV_Trigger
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     WhenToTest PostBattle

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Condition WasAttacker
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and IsGeneral
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and not WonBattle
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleSuccess = crushing
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and I_ConflictType Normal
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleOdds >= 0.5
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and not Toggled gradual trait loss

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Affects BadAttacker  2  Chance  50 

;------------------------------------------
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER Trigger REMASTERED_V0020_Standard_Battle_Attacker_Crushing_Loss_VnV_Trigger
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     WhenToTest PostBattle

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Condition WasAttacker
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and IsGeneral
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and not WonBattle
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleSuccess = crushing
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and I_ConflictType Normal
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleOdds >= 0.5
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and Toggled gradual trait loss
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and Trait GoodAttacker = 0

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Affects BadAttacker  2  Chance  50 

;------------------------------------------
Trigger REMASTERED_CrushingLoss_lower_good_attacker
    WhenToTest PostBattle

    Condition WasAttacker
          and IsGeneral
          and not WonBattle
          and BattleSuccess = crushing
          and I_ConflictType Normal
          and BattleOdds >= 0.5
          and Toggled gradual trait loss
          and Trait GoodAttacker > 0

    Affects GoodAttacker  Lose  2  Chance  50

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER Trigger REMASTERED_V0030_Standard_Battle_Defender_Crushing_Victory_VnV_Trigger
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     WhenToTest PostBattle

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Condition not WasAttacker
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and IsGeneral
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and WonBattle
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleSuccess = crushing
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and I_ConflictType Normal
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleOdds >= 0.5
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and BattleOdds < 1.5
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and Toggled gradual trait loss
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and Trait BadDefender = 0

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Affects GoodDefender  2  Chance  100 
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Affects TacticalSkill  1  Chance  5 

;------------------------------------------
Trigger REMASTERED_CrushingVictory_lower_bad_defender
    WhenToTest PostBattle

    Condition not WasAttacker
          and IsGeneral
          and WonBattle
          and BattleSuccess = crushing
          and I_ConflictType Normal
          and BattleOdds >= 0.5
          and BattleOdds < 1.5
          and Toggled gradual trait loss
          and Trait BadDefender > 0

    Affects BadDefender  Lose  2  Chance  100

;------------------------------------------

    WhenToTest DiplomacyMission

    Condition not MissionSucceeded
          and Trait GoodDiplomat > 0
          and Toggled gradual trait loss

    Affects GoodDiplomat  Lose  1  Chance  100 

;------------------------------------------
Trigger REMASTERED_lower_bad_diplomat
    WhenToTest DiplomacyMission

    Condition MissionSucceeded
          and Trait BadDiplomat > 0
          and Toggled gradual trait loss

    Affects BadDiplomat  Lose  1  Chance  100

;------------------------------------------
Trigger factionleader
    WhenToTest BecomesFactionLeader

    Affects Factionleader  1  Chance  100 

;------------------------------------------
Trigger reinherited
    WhenToTest BecomesFactionHeir
    Condition Trait Exheir = 1

    Affects Factionheir  1  Chance  100 

;------------------------------------------
Trigger disinherited
    WhenToTest CeasedFactionHeir
    Condition not Trait Exheir = 1
          and not IsFactionLeader

    Affects Exheir  2  Chance  100 

;------------------------------------------
Trigger inherited
    WhenToTest CeasedFactionHeir
    Condition IsFactionLeader

    Affects Exheir  1  Chance  100 

;------------------------------------------
Trigger becomesheir
    WhenToTest BecomesFactionHeir

    Affects Factionheir  1  Chance  100 

;------------------------------------------
Trigger demoted
    WhenToTest BecomesFactionHeir
    Condition IsFactionLeader

    Affects Factionheir  1  Chance  100

    Affects SpiritualMilieuJustice       -1  Chance  100 
    Affects SpiritualMilieuLaw           -1  Chance  100 
    Affects SpiritualMilieuLeadership    -1  Chance  100

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and IsGeneral
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and Attribute Command >= 4
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and NightBattlesEnabled

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and Attribute Command >= 1
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and IsNightBattle
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and Trait NightBattleCapable = 0
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and WonBattle
; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER           and NightBattlesEnabled

; OP_ALL_HARDENED_DISABLED_TRIGGER     Affects NightBattleCapable  6  Chance  100 

; YHZ 02-Mar-2020 - Allow adding night traits to descr_strat.txt, and remove them outside of Remastered
;------------------------------------------
Trigger night_battle_not_remastered
    WhenToTest CharacterTurnStart

    Condition Trait NightBattleCapable = 1
          and not NightBattlesEnabled

    Affects NightBattleCapable  -1  Chance  100

    WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd

    Condition AgentType = merchant
          and Trait SpiritualMilieuLove < 4

    Affects SpiritualMilieuLove  4  Chance  100
